## What lives here
The FastAPI backend. It covers the API, accounts and workspaces, the orchestration pipelines that design agents and workflows, the local DAG engine and Mistral Workflows integration, knowledge and graph RAG, the vault, rules, remote servers and observability. It also holds the backend's tests, evals, scripts and one-off developer utilities at its root.

## Conventions
The code lives in `app/`; tests in `tests/` (pytest, no network); benchmarks in `evals/`. Root-level `*.py` files are developer scratch scripts, not part of the app. Configuration comes from `.env` (see `.env.example`), with Settings-page overrides on top.

## Entry points
`app/main.py` (`uvicorn app.main:app`), the `Dockerfile` (production image) and `requirements.txt`.
